tbesh_html:
A woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.14.2; married to Joash (H3101I);
mother of: Amaziah (H0558); also called Jehoaddin at 2Ki.14.2;
§ Jehoaddan = "Jehovah delights"
wife of king Joash and mother of king Amaziah of Judah

strongs_1890.derivation: or יְהוֹעַדָּן; from H3068 (יְהֹוָה) and H5727 (עָדַן); Jehovahpleased;
